items.summary: Recommendation: reject the proposed production and high-priority queue work for this cycle. Available revenue is only partially attributable, measured outcomes are inconclusive, and several recent execution paths failed; these conditions do not support financial claims or new production changes. Keep production work closed, continue existing measurement gates, and repair failed requests through their existing incident work without creating duplicate telemetry or queue actions. No decision is required.
